lines.en: I believe some boys are here to take you to a dance.
Miss Shea, may we escort you to the dance?
What the-- what the-- what the-- what the-- what--
We were expecting a more enthusiastic reaction.
I don't know, it's hard to explain.
I'm just-- I'm just really upset.
Come on, come on, come on, come on, come on, come on, come on.
Look, you guys, I so appreciate you going to all this trouble for me,
but the dance was supposed to be a father-daughter thing.
I was OK with Spencer taking me, but...
even if I went with Spencer, it's just not the same.
No, I just want this night to be over.
I don't want to go to that dance with anyone.
Hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey!
Hey, listen, I would love to hug you all, but I have to take an incredibly beautiful girl to a very special dance.
Yeah, I just need my purse.
Oh, I think Freddy's got it right there.
